title: Bit encoding of a two-tape table
statement: Given a two-tape code table with $n+1$ states, encode its entries as a bit string by listing the states in order and, for each state, listing the actions in lexicographic product order over the three possible input symbols (blank, false, true) and the three possible scanned symbols on each work tape (blank, false, true), encoding each action by its action bit string.
hypotheses_covered: A two-tape code table with $n+1$ states
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the action-to-bit-string encoding or specify the order convention beyond the displayed lists.
